thread:
oncall-bot: Pager alert: gateway-prod - elevated 5xx rate (>5% over baseline) starting now. auto-runbook: https://runbook.redwood/internal/incidents/gw-5xx. Please ack. :rotating_light:

sara: acked. I'm oncall. looking into gateway-prod cluster in us-west-2.

matt: pinging. I'll shadow for mitigation if needed. any customer reports yet?

jamie: support-team reporting a handful of customers seeing timeouts and 502s since ~22:05 UTC. case #C-8234 opened. partial UI errors, some retry loops.

sara: quick triage: traffic spike? checking ingress metrics and LB health. cpu fine, but backend latency climbing.

leo: looking at edge logs: we're seeing a surge of 504s from the model-proxy pool. sample log: ``[edge] req_id= - downstream_status=504 upstream=10.2.4.18:8080``. note: many entries missing req_id (shows `req_id= -`).

ana: (obs) traces look sparse for these requests. span sampling for gateway-prod dropped from 20% -> 2% at 22:02 due to a sampling config flip in the rollout. I'm pulling trace retention and sampler logs.

matt: oof, missing request IDs + low sampling = bad for debugging. we need stopgap instrumentation: 1) enable full request_id injection at the edge 2) bump trace sampling to 25% 3) enable temporary verbose proxy logs for 5m. any objections?

sara: +1 to all. do we have a safe config to flip without deploy? can we toggle via feature flag or SSM?

ops-bot: feature-flag toggle successful: `ff.gateway.request_id_injection = true` (applied to gateway-prod).* 

leo: confirming log lines now include req_id: ``[edge] req_id=0d4a9f upstream_status=200`` for new requests. older in-flight ones still blank.

ana: bumping sampling now. run: ``curl -XPOST https://obs-control/api/sampling -d '{"env":"gateway-prod","sample_pct":25}'`` -> 202 accepted.

matt: adding temporary proxy verbose: ``kubectl -n gateway set env deploy/gateway-proxy LOG_LEVEL=debug --record``. ops-team, monitor pod restarts.

ops-bot: deployment env update submitted, no restarts observed.

jamie: Support: we've notified 2 customers as high priority. Cases C-8234 and C-8235 showing ~30% failure for certain endpoints. No major revenue impact yet but UX broken.

sara: mitigation check: are 5xx rates decreasing?

leo: graph: 5xx spiked to 8% at 22:06, after toggles we're down to ~3.5% and trending down. still above SLO.

matt: root likely twofold: rollout accidentally lowered trace sampling and a regression removed request-id injection from some proxy path. combination made debugging hard. also saw occasional upstream timeouts from model-hosts (latency bursts ~1.8s). I'll open a tracking issue.

ana: we still have trace gaps for ~10% of requests (older ones). I'm re-ingesting the last 5m of logs with request-id patch to correlate. might take ~10min.

sara: customer-facing comms: jamie, can you advise on status text? suggest ETA: mitigation in progress, no full fix yet.

jamie: draft: "We're aware of elevated errors for some API requests affecting retries and some UI paths. Engineers have applied additional logging and tracing to investigate; some customers may see intermittent failures while we roll out mitigations. Expect updates every 15 minutes." Posting to #customer-impact now. :white_check_mark:

matt: action items so far: 1) temporary req_id injection (done) 2) sampling bump (done) 3) verbose logs (done) 4) correlate logs/traces (ana + leo) 5) investigate upstream model-host latency (matt). Assigning myself for 5.

leo: correlation job started: ``python tools/correlate_logs_traces.py --env gateway-prod --since 22:00``. early results: majority of 504s cluster on a subset of model-hosts (m-host-12, m-host-17).

matt: running health checks on those hosts. hitting internal admin endpoints: ``/healthz`` returns intermittent 500s. digging into process logs.

ops-bot: deploy bot reports no recent deploys to model-hosts in last 4h.

sara: could be resource pressure or networking. leo, can you check kube events for m-host-12/17?

leo: checking: ``kubectl -n models describe pod m-host-12`` shows occasional `ReadTimeout` in sidecar to object-store at ~22:03. That aligns with latency bursts.

matt: object-store team, any known issues? @ana do we have network egress metrics?

ana: object-store peer reported brief egress congestion in us-west-2 at 22:02-22:04 due to infra maintenance. they're rolling back throttle. I can open a ticket.

matt: ok that explains upstream timeouts. plan: keep edge mitigations, route some traffic away from affected hosts (circuit-break on m-host-12/17) and coordinate with object-store to ensure stability.

sara: matt, can you implement circuit-break rule? Use routing weight to exclude hosts temporarily.

matt: applying route change: ``kubectl -n models patch svc model-router -p '{"spec":{"weights":{"m-host-12":0,"m-host-17":0}}}'`` -> applied. Monitoring.

leo: after route change, errors dropped further to ~1.2% and infra traces are more complete.

jamie: confirming on support side: customers in C-8234/C-8235 reporting improvement. I'll update cases.

ana: correlation complete. added request_id to 95% of logs and new traces show the flow to object-store timeouts. pushing a postmortem blurb to /incidents after stabilization.

sara: are we comfortable to close pager? I'd like to keep a short watch for 30m.

matt: agree, leave incident in watch mode. I'll keep ownership for next 30m and start postmortem draft.

ops-bot: Pager snoozed for 30m by sara.

support-team: thanks all. will flag any regression.

sara: quick retrospective notes in thread: - root causes: missing request-id injection in some proxy paths + accidental sampler reduction + transient object-store egress congestion. - Mitigations: re-enable request-id injection feature-flag, bump sampling, temporary verbose logs, circuit-break problematic model hosts. - Follow-ups: permanent guardrail to prevent sampler config drift, add automated check to ensure request-id presence in logs, ensure object-store maintenance windows communicated.

matt: adding follow-up tickets: INF-4321 (sampler guardrail), INF-4322 (request-id missing-path fix), INF-4323 (auto-circuit-break metrics + runbook).

sara: thanks team. closing live mitigation. will publish postmortem in ~24h. :pray:
